summary: Flutter's shared error banner now announces workspace errors in TEXT, DM and voice as a live region, matching the corresponding web role=alert surfaces without a voice-only nested announcement wrapper.

checks.name: Flutter text error regression reproduced before implementation
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'announces text conversation errors as live alerts'
checks.observation: Before the fix, the text error remained visible but its semantics did not expose the live-region flag.

checks.name: Focused text error announcement
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'announces text conversation errors as live alerts'
checks.observation: The visible text history error is exposed through a live-region semantic node.

checks.name: Workspace screen widget tests
checks.observation: All 46 workspace screen widget tests pass, including prejoin status and text error announcement regressions.

checks.name: Full Flutter test suite and analyzer
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub; flutter analyze --no-pub
checks.observation: All 288 Flutter tests pass and flutter analyze reports no issues.

checks.name: Native screen-reader announcement priority and timing
checks.observation: Widget semantics were checked, but actual spoken announcement timing/priority was not checked with TalkBack, VoiceOver or NVDA.

remaining: Verify that TEXT/DM/voice errors are announced once, with suitable urgency and focus behavior, through TalkBack on Android, VoiceOver on macOS and NVDA on Windows.
